level_one.title: Third Wind
level_one.description: Increases Health Restoration rate to 90 (+4% per level) per second, and raises Health threshold to 60% Health for improved 180 (+4% per level) per second Restoration.

level_four.title: Reverberation
level_four.description: Increases the Attack Speed Slow of Thunder Clap from 30% to 50% and the duration from 2.5 seconds to 3.5 seconds. Each enemy Hero hit reduces your Heroic Ability cooldown by 5%.

level_seven.title: Heavy Impact
level_seven.description: Enemies hit by Dwarf Toss are Slowed by 80% for 1.5 seconds.

level_ten.title: Avatar
level_ten.description: Transform for 20 seconds, gaining 1000 (+4% per level) Health.

level_thirteen.title: Bronzebeard Rage
level_thirteen.description: Deal 15 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies and heal for 75% of the damage dealt. Hitting an enemy Hero with Storm Bolt increase this damage by 200% for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Imposing Presence
level_sixteen.description: Activate to reduce the Attack Speed by 50% and Movement Speed by 20% of nearby Heroes and Summons for 2.5 seconds.  Passive: Heroes and Summons that attack your Hero have their Attack Speed Slowed by 20% for 2.5 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Mountain King
level_twenty.description: Thunder Clap and Dwarf Toss each gain a 2nd charge.

level_one.title: Overwhelming Affliction
level_one.description: Enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Black Arrows are Slowed by 15%. Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against Slowed enemy Heroes deal 1% of their maximum Health as damage.

level_four.title: Haunting Arrows
level_four.description: Black Arrows can now be activated to cause all Basic Attacks and Abilities to Stun Minions and Structures for 3 seconds. Lasts for 10 seconds. Basic Attacks against Structures reduce this cooldown by 3 seconds.

level_seven.title: Festering Wounds
level_seven.description: Increase Haunting Wave's damage by 15%. Haunting Wave applies 3 stacks of Black Arrows.

level_ten.title: Mind Control
level_ten.description: After 0.25 seconds, fire a missile that Mind Controls the first enemy Hero hit. Heroes hit are Silenced, Slowed by 30%, have 3 stacks of Black Arrows applied to them, and are forced to walk towards Sylvanas for 1.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Remorseless
level_thirteen.description: Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Black Arrows shoot an untalented shot of Withering Fire. This shot of Withering Fire applies Black Arrows.  Increase Sylvanas's Basic Attack range by 1.

level_sixteen.title: Will of the Forsaken
level_sixteen.description: Activate to become Unstoppable and gain 40% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Dark Lady's Call
level_twenty.description: Heroes hit by Mind Control have their vision radius greatly reduced for 5 seconds. Mind Control's cooldown is reduced by 25 seconds.

level_one.title: Pity the Frail
level_one.description: For every Hero hit with Searing Lash, lower the cooldown of Inquisition by 1 seconds. Allies below 30% Health receive 25% more healing from Whitemane.

level_four.title: Martyrdom
level_four.description: Desperate Plea's healing is increased by 30%. Increase this by an additional 10% for each active Zeal.

level_seven.title: Intercession
level_seven.description: Activate to make an ally Unstoppable for 1 second.

level_ten.title: Scarlet Aegis
level_ten.description: Bolster the spirits of nearby allied Heroes, healing them for 300 (+4% per level) and granting them 40 Armor for 4 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Subjugation
level_thirteen.description: Inquisition reduces all damage the target deals by 50%.

level_sixteen.title: Shared Punishment
level_sixteen.description: Upon casting, Inquisition can chain to an additional enemy Hero near its target, dealing 50 (+4% per level) damage every 0.5 seconds. Affected enemies lose 10 Armor.

level_twenty.title: Scarlet Crusade
level_twenty.description: Scarlet Aegis heals for 50% more and makes affected allies Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

level_one.title: Pursuit of Flame
level_one.description: Quest: Hit 30 enemy Heroes with Fel Flame without dying.  Reward: Permanently increase Fel Flame's area by 33%.

level_four.title: Improved Life Tap
level_four.description: Increase the Mana restored by Life Tap to 40%.

level_seven.title: Bound by Shadow
level_seven.description: Each enemy Hero hit with Fel Flame reduces the cooldown of Corruption by 1.75 seconds.

level_ten.title: Horrify
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 120 (+4% per level) damage to enemy Heroes in an area and Fear them for 2 seconds. While Feared, Heroes are Silenced and are forced to run away from Horrify's center.

level_thirteen.title: Healthstone
level_thirteen.description: Activate to heal for 25% of Gul'dan's maximum Health.

level_sixteen.title: Rampant Hellfire
level_sixteen.description: Fel Flame's damage is increased by 12% for 5 seconds when hitting an enemy Hero. This can stack up to 5 times.

level_twenty.title: Haunt
level_twenty.description: Increases the duration of Horrify by 1 second, and while Feared, enemies lose 20 Armor, causing them to take 20% increased damage.

level_one.title: Rocket Boots
level_one.description: Increase the cast range of Xplodium Charge by 30% and its damage by 35%. Hitting an enemy Hero increases Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

level_four.title: Hyperfocus Coils
level_four.description: Heroes hit by Deth Lazor or Xplodium Charge take an additional 2% of their maximum Health in damage. Gazlowe is healed for 150% of the damage dealt.

level_seven.title: Overload
level_seven.description: Deth Lazor can now store up to 2 charges. Each enemy Hero hit by Deth Lazor reduces its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

level_ten.title: Grav-O-Bomb 3000
level_ten.description: After a 1.5 second delay, pull enemies toward the center of an area, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds. Basic Abilities deal 30% more damage for 5 seconds after casting Grav-O-Bomb 3000.

level_thirteen.title: Overcharged Capacitors
level_thirteen.description: Gazlowe gains 5% Spell Power for each active Rock-It! Turret, up to a maximum of 15%. Dealing Basic Attack damage heals Rock-It! Turrets by 8% of their max health.

level_sixteen.title: Ark Reaktor
level_sixteen.description: Reduce the cooldown of Xplodium Charge by 2 seconds. Casting Xplodium Charge creates 3 miniature Rock-It! Turrets that last for 3 seconds.  These Turrets do not drop Scrap or benefit from other Talents.

level_twenty.title: Bomb Toss
level_twenty.description: Xplodium Charge gains a 2nd charge with a 3 second cooldown between uses and launches 2 more bombs when it detonates.

level_one.title: Growing Nightmare
level_one.description: Increase Dread's damage by 50%.  Quest: Hit 3 enemy Heroes with a single cast of Dread's eruption.  Reward: Permanently increase Dread's eruption damage by 50% and increase the Slow amount of Dread's eruption by 15%.

level_four.title: Chaotic Assault
level_four.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes while having 3 stacks of Chaos deal an additional 75% bonus damage.

level_seven.title: Mind Devourer
level_seven.description: Quest: Hitting Heroes with Dread increases its damage by 5, up to 150.  Reward: After hitting 30 Heroes, hitting an enemy Hero with Dread's eruption sets its cooldown to 6 seconds and refunds 50 Mana.

level_ten.title: Crushing Jaws
level_ten.description: After 1.25 seconds, pull enemies in an area towards the center, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage and Stunning them for 0.5 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Abyssal Symbiosis
level_thirteen.description: Hitting a Hero with Chomp instantly grants Orphea maximum Chaos and a 170 (+4% per level) Shield for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Bond of Anguish
level_sixteen.description: Shadow Waltz deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 3% of their maximum Health, healing Orphea for 50% of damage dealt.

level_twenty.title: Engulfing Oblivion
level_twenty.description: Crushing Jaws reduces the Armor of Heroes hit by 50 for 3 seconds. Takedowns set its cooldown to 5 seconds.

level_one.title: Lightwell
level_one.description: Summon a Lightwell that periodically heals a nearby allied Hero for 50 (+4% per level). The well only fades after healing 15 times or when recast.  This cooldown is reduced by 1 second each time Anduin heals an allied Hero.

level_four.title: Piercing Light
level_four.description: Chastise pierces to hit an additional Hero.  Quest: Hitting two Heroes with a single Chastise permanently increases Spell Power by 1, to a maximum of 10.

level_seven.title: Desperate Prayer
level_seven.description: Activate to instantly heal an allied Hero for 375 (+4% per level), but kneel for 2 seconds, unable to act.

level_ten.title: Lightbomb
level_ten.description: Imbue an allied Hero with the Light. After 1.5 seconds, it explodes, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies and Stunning them for 1.25 seconds.  The target gains a Shield that absorbs 165 (+4% per level) damage per enemy Hero hit. Lasts for 5 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Enchant Boots - Lion's Speed
level_thirteen.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. This bonus is quadrupled while Leap of Faith's cooldown is available. Allies pulled by Leap of Faith are healed for 280 (+4% per level) over 4 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Glyph of Faith
level_sixteen.description: Leap of Faith gains a 2nd charge.

level_twenty.title: Inner Fire
level_twenty.description: The target of Light Bomb gains 40% Move Speed and 50 Armor for 3 seconds.

level_one.title: Frost Presence
level_one.description: Increase the area of Howling Blast by 20%.  Quest: Hit enemy Heroes with Howling Blast.  Reward: After Hitting 15 Heroes, Howling Blast's range is increased by 20% and it hits enemies in its path.  Reward: After Hitting 30 Heroes, Death Coil Slows Heroes hit by 50% for 1.25 seconds.

level_four.title: Shattered Armor
level_four.description: Enemy Heroes hit by Howling Blast have their Armor reduced by 15 for 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Immortal Coil
level_seven.description: Gain the healing effect of Death Coil even when used on enemies. If Death Coil is used on Arthas, it heals for an additional 75% bonus healing and its cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.

level_ten.title: Summon Sindragosa
level_ten.description: Deals 230 (+4% per level) damage and Slows enemies by 60% for 4 seconds. Also disables Minions, Mercenaries, Monsters and Structures for 20 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Deathlord
level_thirteen.description: If Death Coil is used on an enemy Hero, launch an additional Death Coil at a nearby enemy Hero.  Passive: Death Coil deals more damage the lower Arthas's current Health is, up to a maximum of 50% bonus damage.

level_sixteen.title: Anti-Magic Shell
level_sixteen.description: Activate to make Arthas immune to Spell Damage for 4 seconds and heal Arthas for 25% of the damage prevented.

level_twenty.title: Absolute Zero
level_twenty.description: Sindragosa flies twice as far. Enemy Heroes are Rooted for 2.5 seconds, and then Slowed by 60% for 4 seconds.

level_one.title: Echo of the Elements
level_one.description: Quest: Kill Minions or Heroes within 2 seconds of hitting them with Chain Lightning.  Reward: After killing 20 enemies, reduce the Mana cost of Chain Lightning from 40 to 20.  Reward: After killing 50 enemies, Chain Lightning gains an extra charge.  Mythic Reward: After killing 125 enemies, Chain Lightning can now strike the same target multiple times, and also strikes 1 additional target per bounce.

level_four.title: Mana Tide
level_four.description: Frostwolf Resilience restores 15 Mana and reduces Basic Ability cooldowns by 0.5 seconds.

level_seven.title: Rolling Thunder
level_seven.description: Passive: Chain Lightning bounces an additional time.  For 8 seconds after hitting an enemy with Chain Lightning, Thrall's next Basic Attack against them grants a stack of Frostwolf Resilience. If the target is an enemy Hero, then he also deals damage to them equal to 3% of their maximum Health and healing for the same amount.

level_ten.title: Sundering
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, sunder the earth in a long line, dealing 290 (+4% per level) damage and shoving enemies to the side, Stunning them for 1 second.

level_thirteen.title: Spirit Shield
level_thirteen.description: Every 45 seconds, gain 70 Spell Armor against the next enemy Ability and subsequent Abilities for 4 seconds. Frostwolf Resilience reduces this cooldown by 10 seconds.  Can be toggled to allow or prevent this talent from triggering automatically.

level_sixteen.title: Thunderstorm
level_sixteen.description: Chain Lightning Slows the primary target by 8% for 2 seconds when used on Heroes.  Quest: Targeting a Hero directly with Chain Lightning increases this Slow by 8%, up to an additional 40%.  Reward: While at a 40% bonus, Chain Lightning's damage is increased by 30%.  Bonuses are reset if Chain Lightning is used on the same Hero it was last used on, or if Thrall dies.

level_twenty.title: Worldbreaker
level_twenty.description: Lower the cooldown of Sundering by 40 seconds. After Sundering impacts, it leaves behind an impassable rift, blocking unit movement for 3 seconds.

level_one.title: Quarterback
level_one.description: Increases Frag Grenade's damage by 10% and its range by 45%.

level_four.title: Master Assassin
level_four.description: Passive: Increase Tychus's Attack Speed by 10%.  Reward: After getting 15 Takedowns, Tychus's Attack Speed is increased by an additional 15%.

level_seven.title: Melting Point
level_seven.description: Enemies hit by Frag Grenade take an additional 75 (+4% per level) damage over 3 seconds. This damage is increased by 100% against Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters.

level_ten.title: Commandeer Odin
level_ten.description: Call down an Odin to pilot. The Odin deals increased Damage, has 100% increased Basic Attack range, and uses different Abilities. The Odin has 25 Armor and lasts 23 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Neosteel Coating
level_thirteen.description: Activate to gain 75 Spell Armor for 4 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 75%.

level_sixteen.title: Titan Grenade
level_sixteen.description: Frag Grenade deals bonus damage to Heroes equal to 5% of their maximum Health. Each enemy Hero hit by Frag Grenade reduces its cooldown by 1 second.

level_twenty.title: Big Red Button
level_twenty.description: Odin lasts 50% longer and Ragnarok Missiles also launches a Nuclear Missile which lands 2.5 seconds later, dealing 319 (+4% per level) damage in its area.
